body:
## Rationale

Follow-up to #8988 (verified-clean, promoted this run). While verifying #8988's scope, the verification pass grepped `HHX` near `richard-christy`/"Richard Christy" across the whole repo (per #8988's own Verify step 3, which asked to check beyond its 4 enumerated locations) and found it fabricated in two additional files #8988 does not touch:

- `api/drummers/index.js:2808` (kitOverview) — "Sabian AAX and HHX Series cymbals... a 21\" HHX Raw Bell Dry Ride"
- `packages/frontend/data/drummerComparisons.js` lines 2308, 2316, 3225, 3231 — "Sabian AAX & HHX cymbals" attributed to Richard Christy

Ground truth (`endorsementNews.js` `richard-christy` entry, cymbals field): Sabian "AA / AAX Series" since 1998. No HHX anywhere in his verified record.

Not a duplicate of #8988 (different files) or closed #8589/#7997/#7404/#6405/etc. (all different files/fields, confirmed via `gh api search/issues`).

## Fix

Replace "Sabian AAX and HHX" / "AAX & HHX" with "Sabian AA/AAX" in the locations above. `api/drummers/index.js:2808` also names a specific "21\" HHX Raw Bell Dry Ride" model with no AA/AAX equivalent in ground truth — per the verified-only/omit-if-unsure rule, drop the specific ride model rather than inventing a replacement.

## Verify

1. `grep -n "HHX" api/drummers/index.js` scoped to the richard-christy block — no remaining hit.
2. `grep -n "HHX" packages/frontend/data/drummerComparisons.js` scoped to Richard Christy entries (lines ~2300-2320, ~3220-3235) — no remaining hit.
3. After this + #8988 both ship, `grep -rn "HHX" --include=*.js | grep -i richard` repo-wide returns nothing.

## Done

No "HHX" string remains attributed to Richard Christy anywhere in the repo, across all files (extendedBios.js + cymbalSetups.js via #8988, api/drummers/index.js + drummerComparisons.js via this issue).
title: SEO: Richard Christy cymbals also fabricated as 'Sabian HHX' in api/drummers/index.js + drummerComparisons.js (4 more locations, #8988 only covers extendedBios.js/cymbalSetups.js)
